summary: Frontend type-check: tsconfig + `npm run typecheck` in CI
description:
Due 2026-11-05. Follow-up from PR #31.

The frontend has no `tsconfig.json`, and `vite build` only transpiles, so type errors never fail anything. That is how `ApprovalDecision['data']` (a type that did not exist) reached a PR.

## Do

* Add `typescript` as a devDependency, plus `tsconfig.json` (strict, `jsx: react-jsx`, `moduleResolution: bundler`, `types: ["vite/client", "vitest/globals"]` as needed) and a `"typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"` script.
* Fix whatever type errors it reports, with the smallest changes. Do not change behaviour.
* Add `npm run typecheck` to the frontend job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

## Acceptance

`npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` all pass locally. CI on the PR is green, with the typecheck step visible in the log. The PR body pastes the three command outputs.

comments.body: [claude] Folded into PR #31 (73acc6c): copilot's re-review asked for a real `tsc --noEmit` check there. It adds TypeScript + strict `tsconfig.json` + `npm run typecheck`, and a "Type-check frontend" step in the CI frontend job. It found 16 errors, all in test mocks, now fixed. This closes when #31 merges. cline: no work left on this ticket.
